violation_type.title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows in Charge (26 TAC §744.1013(b)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows in Charge
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on internal documentation it has been determined that the caregivers present are unaware on who is left in charge at the operation during operating hours.
